title: Coffee, Iced Cafe Mocha, Decaf, Nonfat

content.title: About
content.content: Iced Cafe Mocha is a cold beverage made from espresso, chocolate syrup, and nonfat milk, prepared without caffeine. It combines the aromatic taste of coffee, the sweetness of chocolate, and a light creamy texture while keeping calories low.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first "mocha" originated in Yemen in the 15th century, where coffee was mixed with chocolate.
Decaffeination is usually done by water or CO₂ methods, preserving most flavor notes.
Nonfat milk contains about 90 % less fat but retains most of the protein and calcium.
Cold coffee drinks gained popularity in the US in the 1990s thanks to the rise of Starbucks.
Chocolate syrup is often made from cocoa mass, sugar, and vanilla, giving the drink its distinctive aroma.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Chocolate syrup provides flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Nonfat milk supplies calcium and vitamin D, beneficial for bones and heart.

items.title: Reduced caffeine intake
items.content: Decaf coffee lets you enjoy the flavor without the stimulant effect, useful for caffeine‑sensitive individuals.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Nonfat milk offers about 3 g of protein per 100 ml, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Mood improvement
items.content: Chocolate can boost serotonin levels, helping improve mood.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to casein should choose dairy‑free alternatives.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup adds sugar; those monitoring glucose should watch portion size.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Some brands use artificial flavors; check the ingredient list if you avoid additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Iced Cafe Mocha over ice in a glass. You can top with whipped cream, dust with cocoa powder, or swap regular chocolate syrup for a diet version.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared drink refrigerated in a sealed container for no more than 24 hours. Store nonfat milk at 0‑4 °C and keep chocolate syrup in a cool, dry place.
